request.max_urls.note: One request carries up to 10,000 addresses.

key.file.note: The key is also a text file named after it, at the root of the site, and the file contains the key.

key.format.note: News Distribution makes a random key of 32 letters and digits. The documented length and character limits were not re-read.

urls.same_host.note: Only addresses on the site that owns the key are accepted. A key or host that does not match is refused with 403 or 422.

answer.too_many.note: 429 means too many requests. News Distribution tries again later.

answer.accepted.note: 200 and 202 count as accepted. 400 is a request IndexNow could not read. News Distribution does not retry 400, 403 or 422.

engines.shared.note: One submission is shared with every engine that takes part: Amazon, Bing, Naver, Seznam.cz, Yandex and Yep.

google.not_listed.note: Google is not on IndexNow's list of engines, and the IndexNow pages do not say either way, so the Google News sitemap stays.
